notes: This bounded portable C++ and Java TCK pair observes the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation interaction for a successful Federate Save Begun call. It checks the empty supplied-argument representation and Null returned-argument representation in the adapter-provided standard MIM. The C++ case is verified under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE; the Java source is API-only and provider-runtime execution remains unverified. It does not claim filesystem service-report behavior, provider conformance, or interoperability.
